quality_scenario_interpretation: Explicit audit sensitivity selections, not recovered author QC thresholds or validated uncertainty. Missing PG or velocity is excluded; quality does not prove all errors removed.
velocity_choice: Native northward V component, cm/s. Transect5 nominal orientation is90 degrees true, making north the declared along-slope diagnostic direction. Do not substitute magnitude or infer current identity from sign alone.
depth_choice: All native metre depth coordinates; nominal700m instrument range is not imposed as a hard truncation or physical current bottom.
maximum_operator: All positive-V maxima among valid samples per ensemble; retain ties and shallow/deep valid-domain edge flags. No vertical interpolation, missing-value filling or boundary inference.
branch_assignment: None. Along-crossing ensemble maxima can include inshore branch, offshore branch, opposing flows and transient features. They cannot enter the current-depth register as branch cores until geographic membership and processing are reviewed.
processing_scope: Audit published tabular profiles only. Do not claim the paper's25km smoothing, TPXO9 correction, projected-velocity maxima or published95cm/s value are reproduced.
